personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT with iOS-Native Clean finishes
personality_one_liner: A premium, fast, and highly trustworthy mobile gaming platform with luxurious peach-to-coral accents and soft tactile cards.

spacing.rule: Use 8px grid system. Generous padding around cards (lg or xl) so the UI doesn't feel cramped. Touch targets must be minimum 44pt.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use as a subtle overlay on the hero banner gradient
dont's: Do not use on dense lists or standard cards
Do not use on forms or inputs

screens.name: Splash

states.loading: Full-bleed peach-to-coral gradient with logo centered.

screens.layout: Full screen gradient background using expo-linear-gradient (brandSecondary to brandPrimary). App logo perfectly centered. No status bar background.

screens.name: Login

states.loading: Activity indicator inside the primary Login CTA button.
states.error: Inline error text below the phone number input (red).

screens.layout: Top 30% features a soft peach gradient wave. Content sits in a white rounded sheet overlapping the wave. Large bold 'Welcome Back' title. Phone number input with prefix (+91). Prominent pill-shaped CTA.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The main hub for live games, quick transactions, and promotions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and game tiles.
states.error: Centered 'Failed to load data' with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Sticky Header with user avatar, UID, and notification bell. Below header: A floating 'Wallet Balance' card (solid surface with soft shadow) overlapping a peach-to-coral gradient background section. Quick actions row (Deposit, Withdraw, Support) below the card. A horizontal promotional banner carousel. Followed by vertical lists/rails for 'Popular Games' and 'Trending Games'. Games are displayed as 2-column or 3-column rounded image tiles. Generous lg padding on screen edges.

screens.name: Wallet
screens.purpose: Manage funds, deposit, withdraw, and view transaction history.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for balance and list items.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty wallet with 'No transactions yet'.
states.error: Error toast or inline retry component.

screens.layout: Large primary balance card at the top. Segmented control for (Transactions | Deposits | Withdrawals). Underneath, a scrollable list of transactions. Each row has an icon (green/red), title, date, and amount right-aligned.

screens.name: Deposit
screens.purpose: Seamless fund top-up using QR and UPI.

states.loading: Spinner over the QR code area while generating.
states.error: Red text indicating payment failure or validation error.

screens.layout: Amount input field at top with quick-select chips (₹500, ₹1000, etc.). Below it, a segmented control or cards to select UPI or QR. If QR: display large QR code inside a bordered white card with 'Download QR' and 'Copy UTR' buttons. Bottom sticky 'Confirm Deposit' CTA.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: Manage users, payments, and view platform metrics.
screens.layout: Dashboard summary at top with 4 stat cards (Total Users, Daily Revenue, Pending Deposits, Pending Withdrawals). Below, a grid menu for User Management, Payment Settings, and Reports. Clean, utilitarian, data-dense but using the same brand accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality with iOS-Native Clean finishes. The app should feel premium and trustworthy, not cheap.
No blue, purple, or indigo used anywhere in the app per the core design rules. Use the coral/peach brand palette provided.
Implement the 20px (lg) border radius on all cards and game tiles to match the 'white rounded cards' requirement.
Ensure sticky headers have a glassmorphism effect (expo-blur or expo-glass-effect) when content scrolls behind them.

For the Home screen, create a visually distinct top section using the peach-to-coral gradient. The Wallet Balance card should visually overlap the boundary between this gradient header and the white background below it.
Implement text scrims (gradient overlay) on any image cards where text is rendered on top to ensure WCAG accessibility.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all screens, with filled variants for active states and outlined for inactive states.
Provide empty/loading/error states for all data-fetching screens (Wallet, Transactions, Game lists) taking up flex:1 layout space.
Serialize the provided haptics block to trigger vibrations on user interactions like button presses and tab switches.
